Lessons.Title: Numerical Patterns
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will analyze numerical patterns and use your understanding of place value and operations to find a rule and explain features of the pattern.
Previously, you examined numerical patterns alongside visual patterns (diagrams of pattern blocks, arrangements of shapes, attributes of rectangles, and so on). In this lesson, you focus solely on numerical patterns, without a visual representation. You use your understanding of operations and place value to make sense of and explain patterns in multiples of numbers.
Core relationship: Numerical patterns from arithmetic rules. Identify and test a constant difference or other pattern before extending the sequence.

Local publisher 2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up:  Which One Doesn’t Belong: Stacked Squares	 (10 minutes); Activity 1:  Count by 10 and by 9	 (20 minutes); Activity 2:  Count by 99	 (15 minutes); Activity 3:   Count by 15	 [OPTIONAL] (20 minutes); Cool-down:  Count by 8	 (5 minutes)
Source-aligned Edulytics model: A number pattern is 9, 18, 27. What is the next term?
First-party Cool-down (not gated original): Continue 10, 19, 28 by two terms.
Original visual/physical and peer-explanation activities still require teacher review.
